notes: Elbow locked, palm facing your thigh: swing the straight arm forward and back like a pendulum, 3 times, fast. Same plane as a curl, no sideways motion.
Walk around for about 15 s, arms natural. Not a set: the counter should say 0.
Slow: 3 s up, 3 s down. Count out loud: 11 lifts. All full and strict.
Shake out your arm and fiddle with the strap for about 15 s, without moving the band. Not a set.
Alternate arms; count only the sensor arm's lifts. Count out loud: 10 lifts. All full and strict.

Count out loud: 11 lifts. Lifts 4 and 9: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 2 and 5: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.

Count out loud: 11 lifts. Lifts 7, 8 and 10: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. Lift 4: after it, lower all the way and let the arm hang still for 5 s (count it out loud), then carry on. All other lifts: full and strict.

Fast: as fast as you can while staying in control. Count out loud: 9 lifts. Lift 8: after it, lower all the way and let the arm hang still for 10 s (count it out loud), then carry on. All other lifts: full and strict.
Count out loud: 13 lifts. Lift 12: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. Lift 6: hold 2–3 s halfway up, then finish it. All other lifts: full and strict.
Count out loud: 8 lifts. Lift 4: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. All other lifts: full and strict.
Put the dumbbell down and pick it up again, three times. Not a set.

Count out loud: 16 lifts. Lifts 5 and 8: lift only until your forearm is level, then lower. Lifts 3 and 11: lower only until your forearm is level, then start the next lift. Lift 7: after it, lower all the way and let the arm hang still for 5 s (count it out loud), then carry on. All other lifts: full and strict.

Count out loud: 10 lifts. Lifts 4, 5 and 6: let your elbow swing forward as you lift, then bring it back. Lift 9: after it, lower all the way and let the arm hang still for 5 s (count it out loud), then carry on. All other lifts: full and strict.
Curl until you can't do one more full rep. Count full reps only and TYPE that count at the prompt (Enter would record 0).
Same pendulum swings: elbow locked, palm facing your thigh, forward and back only.
